lock_mode_before.meaning: the pool's lockMode field value set by the onlyGuardian before the checked action

unlock_performed_by_guardian.meaning: the pool unlock (clearing lockMode) was performed by the onlyGuardian via unlockPool

pool_exposed_to_continual_attack_occurre.meaning: the pool became exposed to continual attack that the onlyGuardian tried to prevent by setting lockMode to 3

assumptions: The checked action is the pool unlock (clearing lockMode) referenced by the intent.
lockMode value 3 is the guardian-set protective state prior to the checked action.

unresolved.description: Report does not state who may call rebaseOraclePack or whether the caller is unauthorized; the actor performing the lockMode-clearing action is not identified.
Report does not give the concrete transaction ordering or timing of the rebase relative to the guardian's lock, so the trigger of the exposure is not fully specified.

limitations: The impact is formalized as a Boolean occurrence of pool exposure; the report gives no numeric magnitude for the exposure.
The authorization guard is bound to the guardian-performed unlock observable; code-level binding of unlockPool and rebaseOraclePack is deferred.
